t: The company you end up in
a: وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ وَٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ ۚ وَحَسُنَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ رَفِيقًا
p: Wa man yuṭiʿi-llāha wa-r-rasūla fa-ulā'ika maʿa-lladhīna anʿama-llāhu ʿalayhim mina-n-nabiyyīna wa-ṣ-ṣiddīqīna wa-sh-shuhadā'i wa-ṣ-ṣāliḥīn…
m: And whoever obeys Allāh and the Messenger - those will be with the ones upon whom Allāh has bestowed favor of the prophets, the steadfast affirmers of truth, the martyrs and the righteous. And excellent are those as companions.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
